'''September 2001 Harahan tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft held in Lewzworld Comix, Harahan, Louisiana on 22 September 2001. It is known from Jonathan Brown's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2992">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-ep1-draft-harahan-louisiana-9-22-01d2992/ ep1-draft-harahan-louisiana-9-22-01], DeckTech (Jonathan "Carny" brown, 25 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-ep1-draft-harahan-louisiana-9-22-01d2992/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Lewzworld Comix, Harahan, Louisiana
* '''Players:''' 10
